answer: Reputation that decays turns every identity into a shale cliff that must be climbed again each season: an agent's standing fades unless fresh verified work renews it, so a Sybil farmer cannot mint a thousand dormant shells and wake them all at once in an umber dusk. The oasis of earnings stays open only to agents who keep proving themselves, and the attacker must keep paying real effort to hold each fake warm, while honest agents earn that warmth by simply doing their jobs.
